thread:
jordan: Quick sync for tomorrow's customer launch session (10am PT). Focus: reg page A/B, capture, and immediate routing for clips + leads. Need confirmations by EOD.

rachel: Reg page A/B is live — variant A uses short form, variant B asks for company size. URL: https://go.redwood.ai/launch-session. HubSpot form IDs: A=`hs_aa12`, B=`hs_bb34`.

devin: Prefer B for better qualification but watch conversion delta. I'll add utm params and ensure we can segment.

priya: Zoom: meeting scheduled, cloud recording enabled, auto-transcript on. I'm also enabling local recording on host laptop for redundancy. Co-hosts: @ethan and @rachel.

ethan: I'll run a quick local capture to get a higher-bitrate file for social edits. Also enabling gallery+shared screen in cloud to keep slides separate.

jordan: Good. Primary asks: 1) srt + vtt from Zoom, 2) one 60s highlight clip within 2 hours, 3) full recording to S3 for editing, 4) HubSpot segmentation + SDR ping for high intent.

rachel: Zapier flow set: on Zoom recording ready -> fetch cloud mp4 + transcript -> upload mp4+srt to s3://redwood-marketing/launchsesh/YYYYMMDD/ -> call clipper service for highlights -> export 60s.mp4 to s3 and post Slack. Will also push attendee CSV to S3.

zapier-bot: Zap registered: "Zoom -> S3 + Clipper v3". Trigger test success: true.

devin: For attendance intent: use attended_seconds / session_length. Thresholds: >70% = high, 30-70% = engaged, <30% = cold. High -> create HubSpot task for SDRs, tag `event:launch-2026`, `intent:high`.

priya: Confirming HubSpot workflow name: "Launch - Post Event Routing". Mapping: hs field `utm_campaign` -> `source`, form variant -> `reg_variant`.

jordan: Social clip: Ethan to deliver 60s version and a 20s teaser. Priority: linkedin + x within 2 hours. Use captions from SRT.

ethan: Will produce two clips. Clipper rules: prefer sections with demo + customer quote. If none, use presenter highlight. Zap will send timestamps to clipper.

rachel: Clipper webhook payload example (sent as text): ```
recording_id=ZOOMID123&format=mp4,srt&highlights=60,20&split_on_speaker_change=true
```

jordan: Good. Also privacy/legal note: reg page must include consent checkbox: "I consent to recording and follow-up communications." This must be required for B variant as well.

devin: For A/B reporting, send weekly CSV to analytics and push immediate session-level metrics to #growth with a short summary.

priya: Backup plan: if Zoom cloud failing, we fallback to local upload via SFTP to the same S3 bucket and trigger same clipper webhook. Ethan, can you be ready?

ethan: Yep. I'll have laptop ready and a hot folder sync script. If local file appears, Zap will detect and process.

jordan: Final: timeline checklist — 30m before: co-host confirm, 10m before: start recording test, 0m: go live, +5m: verify cloud recording started, +120m: clip + social assets in S3, +15m: registrant CSV + HubSpot tags pushed.

rachel: I'll post a short pre-mortem thread after first run with any hiccups.

devin: Remember to include CTA in replay email: "Book a 20-min demo" linking to /book. Also include event tag in CRM.

jordan: Thanks team. If the Zap hits an error, ping here and @oncall-marketing. Let's make sure the clip has burned-in captions for X.

zapier-bot: First recording event simulated in test mode. Will switch live on trigger.

priya: All set from events side. See you tomorrow.

jordan: Closing — thanks! Keep this thread for artifact links once processed.
